title: tricuspis pilosa

This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tricuspis pilosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
